reasoning_summary: The deterministic verdict is INCONCLUSIVE with no failed checks, so ACCEPT and REJECT are both ruled out. The mesh, time and domain components are unmeasured for both quantities.

R0 averaging and statistics are small. Drag averaging is 2.147e-05 and statistics is 9.23e-05. Strouhal averaging is 4.791e-06 and statistics is 7.54e-05. These are far below the 0.03 tolerance. R0 has 12 stationary cycles and a drag drift of 9.2298e-05. More run length would add little.

The mesh is the least resolved part of the setup. R0 has 30580 cells and representative_cell_size_D of 0.45745. The wake has 111 streamwise cells, and the last wake cell is 1.0209 D. The wall-adjacent cell is 0.00475 D, with 160 cells around the cylinder. A coarse wake can shift both shedding frequency and drag, so mesh error is the most likely source of an error larger than 3 %.
The time-step risk is lower. R0 uses a backward (second-order) time scheme, max Courant is 0.70408, and there are 632.77 steps per shedding period.
The domain risk is moderate. Blockage is 0.0125, with 30 D upstream, 50 D downstream and a 40 D half-height with symmetryPlane sides. It is still worth measuring, but I rank it after the mesh.

Budget is ample: 0 of 6 experiments used and 0 of 12 relative compute used. A factor of 2.0 gives a linear refinement of about 1.41, which is a clearer signal than the default 1.4142 cell-count factor (about 1.19 linear).

reasoning_summary: The deterministic verdict is INCONCLUSIVE with no failed checks. ACCEPT and REJECT are both ruled out. Missing for Cd: time and domain. Missing for St: mesh, time and domain.

R0 averaging and statistics are negligible. Cd averaging is 2.147e-05 and Cd statistics is 9.23e-05. St averaging is 4.791e-06 and St statistics is 7.54e-05. R0 has 12 stationary cycles and Cd drift is 9.2298e-05. RUN_LONGER would add nothing useful.
R1 refined the mesh and passed for Cd. The R0-to-R1 Cd change is 0.351% (1.3941 to 1.399), and the mesh uncertainty is 0.01405, within 0.015.

For St the demonstrated mesh change is 0.89% (0.15804 to 0.15946). The estimated uncertainty is 0.0356, above 0.015, because it assumes p=2 with Fs=3. A further mesh level from R0 is possible, but only at a factor of at most 2.0 cumulative, so it would need a small factor. R1 cannot be refined further because cumulative refinement 2.83 exceeds the limit of 2.0. A third mesh level would not fix the missing domain and time components.

The domain is completely unmeasured. The setup has 1.25% blockage, 40 D symmetry lateral boundaries, 30 D upstream and 50 D downstream, with a fixedValue outlet pressure. The task says to treat the stream as unbounded. The domain error is not covered by any other run and could be the largest remaining uncertainty for both quantities.
EXPAND_DOMAIN from R0 costs an estimated 1006 s, the cheapest experiment on the menu. From R1 it is not allowed (162400 cells > 160000).
The time risk is lower. The scheme is second-order backward, max Courant is 0.70408, and there are 632.77 steps per shedding period. I rank it after the domain study.
Budget is ample: 1 of 6 experiments used, and 3.34 of 12 relative compute used.
